description: This file is a shell script used for testing date parsing and printing functionalities within a software project. It contains test cases that verify date formatting, parsing, relative time calculations, and various date string representations.

methods.name: check_relative
methods.description: Verifies relative date calculations like '5 seconds ago' by comparing expected output with the actual output from the date tool.

methods.name: check_show
methods.description: Checks different date display formats (iso8601, rfc2822, etc.) by comparing expected and actual outputs for given timestamps.

methods.name: check_parse
methods.description: Validates date parsing from strings into standard format, handling various formats and timezones.

methods.name: check_approxidate
methods.description: Tests approximate date parsing from human-readable expressions like 'now', 'yesterday', 'last tuesday', etc.

methods.name: check_date_format_human
methods.description: Verifies human-readable date representations from relative times.
